reviews.title: Solid little board
reviews.comment: My first mATX motherboard, so that was a new challenge for my fat hands. Despite its smaller size, it was still easy enough to install components, but you will DEFINITELY want to update the BIOS right away. I was having a lot of frame instability issues in Overwatch (which is a BIG problem for a competitive FPS game). Updating the BIOS for the AGESA junk resolved my issues, so if you also encounter that in your games, update the BIOS and confirm that your overclock settings aren't causing instability. Otherwise, no complaints here.
reviews.author: Jacob

reviews.title: Best option for IO and 3 M.2 slots
reviews.comment: Great mobo option. Mainly went with it because it has 3 M.2 SSD slots and also because of the IO, I plug a lot of things in lol. Haven’t had any issues with it and the ASUS BIOS is nice and easy to use
reviews.author: Christian Zaccaria

reviews.title: Excellent board
reviews.comment: Build went flawlessly. Solid board. AMD expo made timing the ram a breeze. Wi-Fi 7 is a huge bump in performance. Lots of powerful USB options. Ample fan headers on board as well.
reviews.author: vwsunangel

reviews.title: Great but for 1 issue for me
reviews.comment: In this case, I got it in, built the PC, looks great, delivered quickly and in great condition, until I tried to connect to the wifi. Wouldn't connect, mind you this isn't my first build and it's literally plug into the only spot on the entire PC it can connect to so not user issue there. Tried downloading drivers after using external wifi connector, still no dice. Rather unhappy I had to spend more to get wifi on a built in piece. Called help and they went through potential issues quick, they want to have it sent to the. So they can fix it. Going to go through with it, will update based on experience.
